title: Urban teachers' nationwide education-sector campaign, suspended in May after February onset
summary: The opened May 27 Los Tiempos article says teachers evaluated nine weeks of street protests and planned to resume June 6. Search-only ANF text reports the protests had been running since February 8 and were suspended May 5; the Ombudsperson search result also dates suspension of pressure measures to May 5.
continuity_status: campaign and pause are reported; exact onset/pause evidence partly search-only
limitations: The exact February 8 onset and May 5 suspension are not verified from an opened body in this package. The attempted ANF body request timed out and the UCB PDF had a separate timeout; neither was retried. June 6 is a future announcement at this time, not May event evidence.
